cond_0242.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The Manufacturing Engineer reports directly to the Engineering Manager and owns manufacturing and production floor activities, executing the build process from start to finish. This role leads new product layout and manufacturing instruction development, drives continuous process and equipment improvement, and takes accountability for root cause corrective actions.
cond_0242.responsibilities:
· Take direction from and/or lead coordination with the Program Manager on product or customer related activities (for example, the Program Manager will assign tasks or project activities to the Manufacturing Engineer)
· Engage directly with customers to understand requirements and criteria and ensure their expectations are met
· Generate Pre- and Post- DfA/DfM analyses and reports for the product (for example, developing competency with [Product name masked] system to create DfX reports on an as needed basis); determine and recommend engineering design changes as needed
· Review and approve NPI preparation process (such as MPI, tooling, SAP production engineering module, etc.)
· Drive production floor execution from pilot run up to mass production, including troubleshooting and correcting issues as needed; instruct, guide, and mentor technicians and operators
· Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing and assembly processes and methods to achieve maximum productivity levels
· Execute data collection to drive continuous process and equipment improvement and root cause corrective actions
O Identify and implement cost reduction
O Lean manufacturing, ISO, etc.
O Value stream maps
O Production floor layout
O TAKT Time Study
O Perform DOE (Design of Experiment)
O Review and analyze product yield
O Own and address all relevant engineering root cause analyses
· Generate and maintain process control plans and Process Failure Mode Effect Analysis (PFMEA)
· Deliver global support for other company plants
· Make capital equipment recommendations
· Lead development of new automated processes using available hardware and software
· Prepare activity reports and other data input as required
· Other miscellaneous tasks as assigned
These tasks are performed in accordance with engineering instructions, company standard operating procedures, professional trainings, customer requirements, and individual experience.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
· Seven (7) years of Manufacturing or Process Engineering experience in a contract manufacturing environment of PCBA and mechanical assemblies
· Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
· Ability to read, analyze, and interpret schematics, technical procedures, and various reports
· Ability to keep accurate documentation
· Solid decision making skills
· Must be self-directed, dependable, and motivated with excellent relationship and time management skills
· Demonstrated effective leadership abilities
· Experience leading teams and projects
· Proficient with MRP systems and Microsoft Office Suite, including intermediate to advanced knowledge of Word, PowerPoint, Access, and Excel
· Strong organizational skills; detail oriented; ability to multitask
· Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form
· Ability to use common sense to solve practical problems
· Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers and employees; interface with other departments and customers as necessary
· Maintain courteous, professional, and effective working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization
· Possess strong communication, coaching, listening, and interpersonal skills with the ability to relate to individuals from multi-cultural backgrounds and build trusting relationships at all levels within the organization
· Possess conflict resolution skills and the ability to apply techniques at all levels of the organization
Preferred Requirements:
· All or some of the following experience:
O Product Documentation (such as BOM, drawing, work instructions, product standard)
O Soldering Process
O Value Stream Map
O MTM (Method of Time Measurement)
O Ergonomic Studies
· CAM Software (CAM 350, AUTOCAD, CAMCAD, [Product name masked], ProE, Solid Works, etc.)
· Develop and maintain courteous and effective working relationships with clients, vendors, and representatives of external organizations
· Expertise in Theory of Constraints
· Experience managing customer commit process
· Experience supporting Quality Management Systems (ISO), Lean and Customer Satisfaction
· Expertise in root cause analysis, problem solving, decision making and project management
· This may include odd hour teleconferences with global facilities

This role supports manufacturing and production floor activities, tracks and executes the build process, and develops manufacturing instructions. The engineer collects data to drive continuous process and equipment improvement and root cause corrective actions, and may perform a variety of tasks in accordance with their training, experience, and skill.

· Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing and assembly processes and methods to obtain maximum productivity levels

O Value stream maps
O Production floor layout
O TAKT Time Study

cond_0358.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The Manufacturing Engineer reports directly to the Engineering Manager. This role supports manufacturing and production floor activities, tracks and executes the build process through the manufacturing floor, handles new product layout and manufacturing instruction development and implementation, and performs data collection to support continuous process and equipment improvement and root cause corrective actions. The Manufacturing Engineer may perform a variety of tasks in accordance with their training, experience, and skill.
cond_0358.responsibilities:
· Receive direction from and/or coordinate with the Program Manager on product or customer-related tasks (for example, the Program Manager will assign tasks or project activities to the Manufacturing Engineer)
· Interface with customers to clarify requirements and criteria to ensure customer expectations are met
· Generate Pre- and Post- DfA/DfM analyses and reports for the product (for example, developing competency with [Product name masked] system to create DfX reports on an as-needed basis); recommend engineering design changes as needed
· Review and approve NPI preparation process (such as MPI, tooling, SAP production engineering module, etc.)
· Support production floor from pilot run up to mass production, including troubleshooting and correcting issues as needed; instruct, help, guide, and mentor technicians and operators in support of production floor activities
· Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing and assembly processes and methods to obtain maximum productivity levels
· Perform data collection to support continuous process and equipment improvement and root cause corrective actions:
O Identify and implement cost reduction
O Lean manufacturing, ISO, etc.
O Value stream maps
O Production floor layout
O TAKT Time Study
O Perform DOE (Design of Experiment)
O Review and analyze product yield
O Address all relevant engineering root cause analyses
· Support and/or generate process control plans and Process Failure Mode Effect Analysis (PFMEA)
· Provide support for other company plants as required
· Make capital equipment recommendations
· Assist with the development of new automated processes using available hardware and software
· Prepare activity reports and other data input as required
· Other miscellaneous tasks as assigned
These tasks are performed in accordance with engineering instructions, company standard operating procedures, professional trainings, customer requirements, and individual experience.

· Seven (7) years of Manufacturing or Process Engineering experience in a contract manufacturing environment of PCBA and mechanical assemblies
· Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

O Soldering Process
O Value Stream Map

· Develop and maintain professional and effective working relationships with clients, vendors, and representatives of external organizations

The engineer collects data to drive continuous process and equipment improvement and root cause corrective actions, and may perform a variety of tasks in accordance with their training, experience, and skill.
cond_0537.responsibilities:
· Work closely with the Program Manager on product or customer related activities, including taking on assigned tasks and project activities, and staying in regular contact to keep things moving
· Connect with customers directly to understand requirements and criteria, clarify expectations, and handle questions as they come up
· Generate Pre- and Post- DfA/DfM analyses and reports for the product, including developing competency with [Product name masked] to create DfX reports as needed; recommend engineering design changes as needed
· Review and approve NPI preparation process (such as MPI, tooling, SAP production engineering module, etc.)
· Support production floor from pilot run up to mass production, including troubleshooting and correcting issues; instruct, help, guide, and mentor technicians and operators on an ongoing basis
· Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing and assembly processes and methods to obtain maximum productivity levels
· Collect data to drive continuous process and equipment improvement and root cause corrective actions:
O Identify and implement cost reduction
O Lean manufacturing, ISO, etc.
O Value stream maps
O Production floor layout
O TAKT Time Study
O Perform DOE (Design of Experiment)
O Review and analyze product yield
O Support and/or address all relevant engineering root cause analyses
· Support and/or generate process control plans and Process Failure Mode Effect Analysis (PFMEA)
· Provide global support for other company plants, including occasional odd-hour teleconferences with global facilities
· Make capital equipment recommendations
· Assist with the development of new automated processes using available hardware and software
· Prepare activity reports and other data input as required
· Other miscellaneous tasks as assigned
